versions.changelog:
- Initial release of anti-slop.
- Detects and removes overused AI patterns in writing and code, such as formulaic vocabulary, sycophantic phrases, excessive formatting, and common code anti-patterns.
- Provides a self-edit workflow: draft content normally, then edit for slop patterns using supplied references.
- Targets both prose (essays, documentation, reports, creative writing) and code (over-engineering, error handling, abstraction issues).
- Includes quantitative tools and detailed checklists for editing high-stakes or long-form documents.
